durableDelivery.batching: every ring carries all non-stalled pending messages
durableDelivery.idempotency: just before each write ChatGPT re-reads the item's thread on current main (data only) and re-applies the durable-queue rule (B-05: skip silently if CLOSED / SUPERSEDED after the wake, or a resolving reply / hand-off / receipt exists); first resolving reply canonical, duplicates ignored and reported as validate warnings
durableDelivery.limits: no usage monitor, no reset-time guess: an exhausted allowance or unavailable recipient yields no reply and the backoff waits (WAIT_FOR_ALLOWANCE / WAIT_FOR_RESET); no paid fallback; task writes nothing partial
